content.title: Reanimating Royalty
content.body:
§lHow To Summon The Skeleton King:
      §l1. §rHead to a desert.
      §l2. §rFind the §o"King's Crown"§r inside desert pyramids, tombs or ruined structures.
      §l- §rAlternatively, the crown can be dropped by §oOsvermis §ror §oForsakens§r.
      §l3. §rSearch for §oForsakens§r in Deserts or Savannas.
      §l4. §rSlain enough to acquire (6) §oShards of Reminiscence§r.
      §l5. §rCraft the §oCursed Crown§r.
      §l6. §rFind §oSkeleton Heads§r (sometimes seen inside abandoned strutures).
      §l7. §rPlace the head on the desert and give it the crown to summon the Skeleton King.
